recipes.name: Quick & Easy Aglio e Olio
ingredients: ½ cup (10g) fresh parsley, finely chopped
instructions: Bring a large pot of heavily salted water to a boil. Add the spaghetti and cook according to package instructions.

In a separate large saute pan set over medium-low heat add olive oil and garlic. Season with salt, stirring frequently, until softened and fragrant, about 1-2 minutes. Turn off the heat then add the red pepper flakes.

Once the pasta is done, reserve ½ cup of pasta water then drain. Add the pasta to your saute pan and begin tossing aggressively. Add a splash of pasta water at a time until a nice glossy sauce coats the noodles. Season to taste with salt again then stir in the chopped parsley.
Twirl a generous portion onto a plate then optionally top with grated Parmigiano Reggiano. Serve and enjoy!
